name: Responsive Filterable Portfolio
author: Nks

sections.description:
Responsive Filterable Portfolio lets you showcase your work in a clean, mobile-friendly grid that visitors can filter by category with a single click. Add images, YouTube and Dailymotion videos, or clickable links, organize them with tags, and your portfolio rebuilds itself automatically with smooth filtering and a built-in responsive lightbox.

It works anywhere on your site through a simple shortcode or the included Gutenberg block — no theme editing and no code required.

Live Demo  |  Pro Version

Why you’ll like it

  • One-click tag filtering — visitors filter your portfolio by category instantly, with no page reload.
  • Images, video and links in one grid — mix photos, YouTube and Dailymotion videos, and clickable links together.
  • Automatic video thumbnails — paste a video URL and the thumbnail, title and description are fetched for you.
  • Built-in responsive lightbox — media opens in an elegant popup that looks great on every screen size.
  • Gutenberg block included — drop your portfolio into any page from the block editor, or use the shortcode if you prefer.
  • Fully responsive — both the grid and the lightbox adapt smoothly from desktop to phone.
  • Live preview — see exactly how your portfolio looks before you publish it.
  • Easy styling — set thumbnail height, width, spacing and background color from the settings page.
  • Translation ready — fully localizable for any language.
  • WebP support — use modern, lightweight image formats.

Perfect for

Photographers, designers, agencies, freelancers, videographers and anyone who wants a filterable gallery or portfolio that just works.

Free vs Pro

The free version gives you a complete, fully working filterable portfolio with image, YouTube and Dailymotion media, the lightbox, the Gutenberg block and live preview.

The Pro version adds, for those who need more:

  • Unlimited separate portfolio grids
  • More video sources: Vimeo, Metacafe and self-hosted HTML5 video
  • Masonry & Justified layouts
  • Pagination for large portfolios
  • Media descriptions and thumbnail captions in the lightbox
  • Custom media ordering with mass order update
  • Choose to open media in a lightbox or redirect to a link
  • Mass image upload
  • Multisite support and a fully responsive admin
  • No ads, with priority support

Pro features are not included in the free download. See everything in Pro »

Get Support

License

This plugin is free for everyone. Since it is released under the GPL, you can use it free of charge on your personal or commercial site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the responsive-filterable-portfolio folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly from Plugins → Add New in your dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Responsive Portfolio menu to start adding media.

Usage

  1. Go to the Responsive Portfolio menu after activating the plugin.
  2. Add and organize your media from the Manage Media menu.
  3. Adjust appearance from the Portfolio Settings menu.

  4. Add the portfolio to any page or post with the shortcode:

    [print_responsive_portfolio_plus_lightbox]

Or add it directly in a theme template with:

<?php echo do_shortcode('[print_responsive_portfolio_plus_lightbox]'); ?>

You can also insert it visually using the included Responsive Filterable Portfolio Gutenberg block — no shortcode needed.
sections.faq:
How do I add the portfolio to a page?

Use the Gutenberg block called “Responsive Filterable Portfolio”, or paste the shortcode [print_responsive_portfolio_plus_lightbox] into any page, post or widget.

What media types can I add in the free version?

Images, YouTube videos, Dailymotion videos, and clickable links. The Pro version additionally supports Vimeo, Metacafe and self-hosted HTML5 video.

Can visitors filter the portfolio by category?

Yes. Assign tags to your media and visitors can filter the grid by those tags with a single click, with no page reload.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. Both the portfolio grid and the lightbox are fully responsive and adapt to any screen size.

Do I need to know any code?

No. Everything is managed from the admin screens, and you add the portfolio with a block or a shortcode.

Can I have more than one portfolio grid?

The free version supports one portfolio grid. The Pro version lets you create unlimited separate grids.

How do I change the thumbnail size or background?

Open the Portfolio Settings page, where you can set thumbnail height, width, spacing and background color.

I added a video but the thumbnail did not appear. What should I do?

For YouTube, please use a full youtube.com URL rather than a youtu.be short link, then click the button to fetch the video information and thumbnail.
